overlap_repulsion.description: Quadratic penalty for atom pairs closer than a per-element-pair floor derived from covalent radii (covalent_scale * (r_i + r_j)). r_min is a hard lower clamp only. A single global r_min cannot serve a multi-species system: the value that protects Si-O (~1.4 A) lets O-O (2.2 A) and Si-Si (2.6 A) collapse, so the previous r_min=1.0 admitted Si-O at 1.05 A.

li_constraints.description: Soft repulsive penalty applied to Li atoms to prevent unphysical overlaps. Li atoms are EXCLUDED from the neighbour search used for P order-parameter calculations (element_filter already restricts to Z=15,16).

metadata.cutoff_description: Distance cutoff for P-S neighbor finding
metadata.notes: Constraints for v6 EnvironmentConstrainedOptimizer with adaptive penalties
